scanner.title: Scan book page
scanner.subtitle: Capture or upload a clear book page to recognize Vietnamese text.
scanner.heading: Place page in camera frame
scanner.guide: Keep the book vertical, well-lit, and within the 4 corners, or upload a photo to perform accurate OCR.
scanner.step1Body: Normalizing EXIF orientation and optimizing image clarity…
scanner.step2Body: Sending image to Vietnamese OCR engine…
scanner.jobHeadlineQueuedOffline: Page saved in the OCR queue — Recognition will start automatically when the OCR server comes back online
scanner.openLibraryForReading: Open library to start reading session
scanner.cameraNotReadyBody: Cannot access camera or permission is disabled. You can use the camera button or select an image to scan.
scanner.cameraOffBody: Enable the live scanner or take a clear photo using your phone's native camera—images are automatically rotated and optimized for Vietnamese diacritics.
scanner.afterMatchBody: ViRead will open the book details for you to select the page range. The microphone will be checked during the reading preparation step.
scanner.errorCancelled: Page recognition task cancelled. You may select a different image.
scanner.errorTimeout: Page recognition timed out. Please tap Retry with this image.
scanner.errorWorkerOffline: The Windows OCR server is currently disconnected. Please check the OCR server and tap Retry.
scanner.errorWithDetail: Unable to recognize Vietnamese text in this image ({detail}). Please take a clearer photo or tap Retry.
scanner.errorGeneric: Unable to recognize the page at this time. Please ensure the photo is clear and well-lit, then tap Retry.
scanner.errorTooLargeAfterOptimize: The image exceeds the 12 MB limit after optimization. Please choose a clearer, smaller image.
scanner.errorQueuedTooLong: The image is still in the queue waiting for the Windows OCR server. Please tap Retry once the server is ready.
scanner.errorSessionExpired: Session expired. Please log in again to continue scanning the book page.
scanner.errorSubmitFailed: Cannot connect to local OCR server. Please try again.
scanner.errorUnsupportedFormat: Unsupported image format. Please select JPG, PNG, or WebP.
scanner.errorEmptyFile: Image file is empty. Please select another image.
scanner.errorFileTooLarge: Image exceeds 32 MB limit. Please select a smaller file.
scanner.workerOfflineBannerBody: The OCR server is temporarily offline — You can still capture or upload pages to save them in the queue; recognition will start automatically when the server comes back online.
scanner.workerUnreachableBannerTitle: OCR server is starting up or temporarily unreachable
scanner.workerUnreachableBannerBody: Could not verify OCR server status right now due to startup or a slow connection. You can still upload images to queue them or retry checking in a few seconds.
scanner.queuedListHeading: Other pages saved in the OCR queue ({count} pages)
scanner.jobSubtitleQueuedOffline: Queued waiting for the Windows OCR server to come back online — your page image is safely saved even if you reload.

camera.missingBookInfo: ViRead recognized the page but missing book info. Please align and scan again.
camera.invalidPageInfo: ViRead did not receive valid page info. Please align and scan again.
camera.connectingMessage: Connecting to ViRead. Keep the book steady.
camera.pausedStatus: Camera paused. Tap to resume scanning.
camera.alignGuideStatus: Place the page vertically within the 4 corners for fastest recognition.
camera.pausedBody: Tap below to restart the camera or select an image.
camera.deniedTitle: Cannot enable camera on this device
camera.deniedBody: Please grant Camera access to ViRead or use the Select book page button below.
camera.holdSteadyOverlay: Valid frame · Hold steady to match page
camera.alignCornersOverlay: Align the 4 edges of the page within the frame
camera.fallbackUploadAction: Capture with Camera / Select clear photo (OCR)
